Package com.project.cooking.finance

Class FinancialReport

java.lang.Object
com.project.cooking.finance.FinancialReport
public class FinancialReport extends Object
The FinancialReport class generates financial reports, including total revenue, transaction breakdown, and detailed transaction data. It tracks transactions within a specified date range and calculates total revenue.
Author:
abood
